Kadabra

Psychic

Kanto · Generation 1

Kadabra is a Psychic-type Psi Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 56.5 kg. It evolves from Abra and into Alakazam. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (120), with a base stat total of 400.
